name: Rise of the Snake Deity (Retro Formats)
desc: Activate only when a face-up "Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes" you control is destroyed. Special Summon 1 "Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes" from your hand or Deck.

cdb_provenance.detail: type, atk, def, level, race, attribute and setcode are copied from the row for the modern card (16067089) in cards.cdb at the ignis-babelcdb revision pinned in data/sources.json. They are NOT independently checked against a period printing: a stat change between the period card and the modern one would not be reproduced. category (a client search filter, not gameplay) is left 0 rather than copied. ot is 8 (SCOPE_ILLEGAL) as for every historical-implementation row upstream.

modified.summary: activation allowed in the Damage Step (EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP), so destruction by battle also triggers it, as the period text has no "except by battle".

authorship.note: Adapted from Project Ignis's script for the modern card, official/c16067089.lua at the ignis-cardscripts pin, by applying only the period difference the erratum record states (the summary above) and pointing the effect description at the modern card's strings, because this generated row carries none. It is licensed AGPL-3.0-or-later like its upstream (LICENSES/AGPL-3.0-or-later.txt); the rest of this repository stays MIT. Round 031 labelled it original, written without opening any Project Ignis card script; round 031's review measured that version as too close to this upstream file to be independent, and the owner decided on 2026-09-27 that such scripts are credited, labelled derived and kept under the upstream's licence. Round 032 rebased it on the upstream file itself.

not_reproduced: Damage Step activation is the engine's own window for a card carrying EFFECT_FLAG_DAMAGE_STEP: the record's sources establish that the period text carries no Damage Step exclusion, not where in the Damage Step a period player could have activated it. Only the fact that it is offered after Vennominon is destroyed by battle is tested.

"Is destroyed" is implemented as any destruction of a face-up "Vennominon the King of Poisonous Snakes" the activating player controlled (its previous position and controller on the field); whether it must also have reached the Graveyard is not stated by the period text and is not required.

"Vennominaga the Deity of Poisonous Snakes" comes from the hand or the Deck into any free Monster Zone in face-up Attack Position. The engine refused the Special Summon while Vennominaga's own summoning condition was checked, and the period text does not say how that condition was met, so the Special Summon ignores summoning conditions and then counts as a proper Summon of Vennominaga (CompleteProcedure), as in the upstream script. That it can be Summoned is tested; that it may later be revived is not.
The Trap row has no statline; its type and text come from the modern row and the record.
